tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, defaultLocale, tagConfigured). Pass marketplace + locale on shopping tools. Honest search-mode: tagConfigured may be false until real Associates IDs.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search pet welcome-kit / first-30-days supplies on a specific Amazon marketplace. Returns PA-API products or search deep-link cards (omit ?tag= until real Associates IDs). Requires marketplace + locale. Alias tool name: search_kits.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create an empty pet welcome-kit list. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. Requires marketplace + locale.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to an existing pet kit list (requires editToken). Requires marketplace + locale.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buyUrl / affiliateUrl on the chosen marketplace. Requires marketplace + locale. Omits ?tag= until real Associates IDs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
